subsystem_wing_membrane_flexible_tpu.structural_purpose: Aerodynamic self-healing patagium wing membrane skin. Employs 0.20mm layer steps to track complex organic curves cleanly. The 3-wall shell definition maximizes tensile elasticity, allowing the internal parametric auxetic truss geometries to stretch, twist, and pull inward under shear damage to close tears naturally.

subsystem_data_conduits_conductive_cf_pe.structural_purpose: EMP-proof coaxial diagnostic data conduit tracks. Requires a 0.4mm hardened steel nozzle to prevent structural abrasion from embedded carbon strands. Slower 5.0 mm³/s execution windows force deep layer-to-layer weld lines, creating a solid, continuous conductive tube that behaves like a Faraday shield to block electrostatic radiation and high-altitude EMP interference.
